lessons.title: En mi opinión
lessons.tip: Para dar tu opinión, varía: «I think…», «In my opinion…», «As far as I'm concerned…». ¡Suena mucho más natural!

exercises.prompt: ¿Cuál NO sirve para dar una opinión?

exercises.sentence: I ___ that public transport should be free.
exercises.hint: Creo que el transporte público debería ser gratis.

exercises.prompt: En mi opinión, la ciudad es demasiado ruidosa.
exercises.answer: In my opinion, the city is too noisy.

exercises.text: I don't think it's a good idea
options: I don't think it's a good idea
I think it's a good idea
I didn't know it was your idea
exercises.answer: I don't think it's a good idea

exercises.sentence: I'm not sure I agree ___ you.

alternatives: I don't think it is expensive
I do not think it's expensive
I do not think it is expensive

lessons.title: Planes de futuro
lessons.tip: «Going to» es para planes ya decididos; «will» para decisiones del momento o predicciones. «I'm going to study» vs. «I'll get it!»

exercises.sentence: Next summer we're ___ to visit Scotland.

exercises.prompt: Voy a empezar un curso de cocina en septiembre.
exercises.answer: I'm going to start a cooking course in September.

exercises.text: What are you doing this weekend?
options: What are you doing this weekend?
What did you do last weekend?
What do you do at weekends?
exercises.answer: What are you doing this weekend?

exercises.sentence: I'm meeting my friends ___ Saturday evening.

exercises.answer: I think it will rain tomorrow
alternatives: I think it's going to rain tomorrow
I think it is going to rain tomorrow

exercises.sentence: I'm really looking forward to ___ you.
